_comment: The scan-plan port-spec rule (tcp_ports / udp_ports), case by case. Read by shared/discovery (ParsePortSpec, Go: scan_ports_vectors_test.go) AND by frontend-v2's discover-port-spec.test.ts (parsePortSpec, TypeScript), so the Discover wizard's Custom fields and the platform cannot disagree about what a port list means or what a person is told when one is wrong (#2170, hole H8: the old field read 8000-8100 as 8000). Errors are compared word for word. A case with `repeat` builds its input as unit x times + suffix.

cases.error: port spec is empty
port spec is empty
port spec entry 2 is empty
port spec entry 2 is empty
port spec entry "0": port 0 is out of range 1-65535
port spec entry "00000": port 0 is out of range 1-65535
port spec entry "65536": port 65536 is out of range 1-65535
port spec entry "999999": port 999999 is out of range 1-65535
port spec entry "000001": port 000001 is out of range 1-65535
port spec entry "100-80": range start 100 is greater than its end 80
port spec entry "http": "http" is not a port number
port spec entry "+22": "+22" is not a port number
port spec entry "-5": missing port number
port spec entry "5-": missing port number
port spec entry "1-2-3": a range has exactly one '-'
port spec entry "22;80": "22;80" is not a port number
port spec entry "22 80": "22 80" is not a port number
port spec entry "0x16": "0x16" is not a port number
port spec entry "２２": "２２" is not a port number
port spec entry "1\x012": "1\x012" is not a port number
port spec entry "\ufeff22": "\ufeff22" is not a port number
port spec entry "2\u00a02": "2\u00a02" is not a port number
port spec entry "a\"b\\c": "a\"b\\c" is not a port number
port spec is 6001 bytes; the limit is 4096
port spec has 1101 entries; the limit is 1024
port spec is 4403 bytes; the limit is 4096
